title: Video gaming worldwide - statistics & facts
description: Gone is the niche and nerd reputation; with about two billion global gamers and gaming titles being available on almost every digital device, video games are one of the most popular and enduring hobbies worldwide. Gamer preferences can vary vastly across age groups, genders, and regions – luckily, there is a seemingly infinite range of games to choose from.
